capabilities: scan the vault for dangling images on startup
track file and image changes while Obsidian is running
view and delete unused images in a dedicated UI
extras: README notes future ideas live in a TODO.md and links to source code on GitHub; the manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin warning. The Screenshots section is empty.
problem: Deleted or moved notes can leave image attachments orphaned in the vault, and Obsidian offers no built-in way to find and remove them.
summary: Vault scanner that finds unused (dangling) image files and deletes them from a simple UI opened by command.
